== English Virtual Original comparison ==
December/January/October same operative state. Removes activation and Lost Pile-to-hand selection, provides specific retrieval instead. Later cost must come from the top Reserve Deck card; affected combat card goes to owner's Lost Pile. Senators and Rebel Barrier unchanged. Later exact black Permanent Weapon and orange Maintenance glyphs.
